d.gap: HingeAngleSource.choose() treats events>0 as permanently reporting and has no candidate freshness/demotion; a silent finer public source can indefinitely suppress live coarser candidates. Fold7AngleAuthority also has no scheduled expiration for current public authority.
d.boundary: Public candidate health/selection and stale-public ownership only; excludes precise-to-public discontinuity, ingress overflow, presentation readiness, process recovery, and diagnostics.
d.firstTest: Fine source emits then goes silent while coarser registered source continues; compare production-faithful selector to freshness oracle.
d.en: Discovery complete. Selected a fresh Alpha3 input-truth gap: public hinge candidate liveness/failover. Current code can keep a silent finer candidate selected forever and discard live coarser events; deterministic source-faithful tests reproduced the behavior. No production changes are authorized or made.
